title: WEF Data Policy 2020-2021 roster expansion depth 1
summary: The first roster-expansion pass recovers eight named Data Policy members with person-level evidence plus Dawex as a separate organization-level member. Five people now have dated membership evidence, three have direct but incompletely dated membership evidence, and three exact people recur on the fixed 2023-2024 Data Equity roster. Alberto Giovanni Busetto additionally appears on the current Data Frontiers roster, establishing the first source-backed three-generation carryover sequence.

gaps: Eight named people plus one organization do not yet constitute the full WEF-described 30-member Data Policy roster.
Hsiao, Solomon and Massé remain incompletely dated in the reviewed direct membership sources.
Archived first-party WEF member-list and transformation-map surfaces remain the best route to close the historical roster.
caveats: The three Data Policy-to-Data Equity matches establish recurrence, not continuous service across the intervening period.
Busetto's three-generation recurrence is a membership sequence only and does not establish common policy positions, influence, control or sponsorship.
Dawex remains an organization member and is not counted as a person in carryover counts.

provenance.method: exact council-name roster expansion and fixed-roster identity crossmatch

data.question: What additional Data Policy members can be source-recovered, and which recur across later WEF data-governance councils?
data.method: Prioritize dated authoritative biographies, retain direct undated WEF membership claims, separate organization membership, then exact-name crossmatch against the fixed Data Equity and Data Frontiers rosters.
data.scope: Public professional membership in WEF Data Policy, Data Equity and Data Frontiers generations.
findings: JoAnn Stonier is date-anchored as Data Policy co-chair by December 2020 and later co-chairs the 2023-2024 Data Equity council.
Maria-Elena Torres-Padilla is directly dated to the 2020-2021 Data Policy term, with one biography specifying October 2020 through September 2021.
Sina Fazelpour is directly dated as the 2020-2021 Council Fellow.
Wafa Ben-Hassine's professional biography dates her Data Policy membership to 2020 and WEF independently confirms historical membership.
Adecco Group identifies Alberto Giovanni Busetto as a WEF Global Future Council on Data Policy member in 2021.
WEF directly confirms Data Policy service for Katherine Hsiao and Brett Solomon; Access Now directly confirms Estelle Massé membership, though the recovered sources do not fully date those intervals.
Exact crossmatching establishes Data Policy-to-Data Equity recurrence for JoAnn Stonier, Katherine Hsiao and Alberto Giovanni Busetto.
Busetto also appears on the current 2025-2026 Data Frontiers roster, establishing a three-generation Data Policy-to-Data Equity-to-Data Frontiers recurrence.
conclusions: At least three source-supported person carryovers link the recovered Data Policy surface to Data Equity.
Busetto is the first directly supported person found in all three data-governance generations reviewed.
A denominator-based carryover rate remains premature until historical roster coverage improves.
limitations: Current search indexes do not expose a complete historical WEF Data Policy member list.
unresolved: Remaining approximately 22 historical Data Policy member slots relative to WEF's 30-member description
